description: Builds a boundary's polygon as a file (geojson, kml, wkt, svg or gml) at a detail level and returns a permanent public URL on our CDN; the REST route redirects straight to it. Use it for large polygons, GIS tools and bulk downloads. Costs 1 unit; each file is built once and then shared. Needs an API key or a connected account.

detail.description: Simplification relative to the boundary's size: low (~1,000 points across, maps and previews), medium (default, ~5,000), high (~25,000), full (unsimplified OSM).

format.description: geojson (a Feature), kml, wkt, svg or gml.

id.description: Boundary id: r<OSM relation id> (e.g. r62422 for Berlin) or w<way id>. Also accepts R62422, relation/62422, -62422, an openstreetmap.org URL, wikidata:Q64 or iso:US-CA.

name: export_boundary
title: Export boundary file
